name: hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw-g1-COMMIT
purpose: OWNERS-HBM/VM-GLUE2 2026-10-18 rev 2 (HBM d4g plan (b), GEN2 binding): VM hub glue tile for NW (hb_vms_NW) = ot_vms_slice_static_glue (ot_vms_hub_static + 2 ring stops + ot_vms_rcl_static + ot_vms_status_static; 8 banks are die-level instances) with the ring stops as ot_vms_rstop_static_vr (valid-only reset, logic verbatim). Tile top hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw_t (gen_vms_glue_tiles.py): one clock (OT_SPINE), rst_n -> ot_rst_relay, REGISTERED FACES: every port passes a pin flop + 2 relay flops (<= ~410 um a stage over the 777.6 x 1555.2 pin-bound outline), per-bank bank ports.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw_t u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_tiles.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/hfd_hgi_vms_static_glue.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_hub_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_rstop_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_rstop_static_vr.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_rcl_static.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_status_static.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw --out {RUN}/record/views/hfd_hgi_vms_glue_nw_t  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: VM-GLUE2 rev 2 LATENCY (for the compiler / VM calendar owner): every hub-tile input +3 cycles and every output +3 cycles (pin flop + 2 relays a face; the measured rev-1 setup WNS -1,744 ps came from single-cycle hub / ring-stop logic spanning 1-2.4 ns of wire); ring transit through a hub +6; bank access round trip (pq -> pr, xq -> xq_done) +6, absorbed for the commit check by slice BANK_PIN_IN 1 -> 7 (COMMIT_DELAY 6 -> 12); calendar inputs (enables, sources, seqs, clients, replay) are issued 3 edges earlier for the same effect; reset release +3 (ot_rst_relay).
